introHtml: Rainbow mobile devices bring a vibrant, playful energy to any promotional campaign. The Eclaire Bright Illuminated Stylus Pen, for example, combines a rainbow gradient with a built-in light for a fun, functional touch. Customize with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a lasting impression.
